% 27.02.2019 Cm APPLs. 36246/2018, 45177/2018, 45309/2018
These applications have been filed by the applicants to implead them as party respondents.

W.P.(C)
1214/2018 & CM APPLs. 39133/2018, 45176/2018, 45310/2018 & 45311/2018 Amended memo of parties be filed by the petitioner.

We are informed that Pollution Control Board has given consent to the Delhi Agricultural Marketing Board (DAMB) to permit the eligible applicants to operate poultry and egg market subject to the terms and conditions stipulated in the said consent order.
Let the said consent order be brought on record along with an affidavit.
The petitioner may respond to the same.
A communication made by the Union of India is brought to our notice with regard to complying with the mandatory requirements of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

Let a copy of the said communication be brought on record and the Delhi Agricultural Marketing Board/EDMC respond Gauri Maulakhi vs Delhi Agricultural Marketing Board And ... on 27 February, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/139428140/
